"def GS(A, b, eps, x_true, x0):
    """
    Solve a given linear system Ax = b using Gauss-Seidel iteration.

    Parameters
    ----------
    A : ndarray, shape (N, N)
        Coefficient matrix.
    b : ndarray, shape (N,) or (N, 1)
        Right-hand side vector.
    eps : float
        Convergence tolerance for the L2 norm of the increment.
    x_true : ndarray, shape (N,)
        Exact solution (used for error computation).
    x0 : ndarray, shape (N,)
        Initial guess (typically the zero vector).

    Returns
    -------
    residual : float
        L2 norm of the residual ||A x - b||_2.
    error : float
        L2 norm of the error ||x - x_true||_2.
    """
    # Prepare arrays
    x = x0.astype(float).copy()
    b = b.astype(float).ravel()
    A = A.astype(float)

    N = A.shape[0]
    diag = np.diag(A)                     # a_ii values

    max_iter = 10000
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        x_old = x.copy()

        # Gauss‑Seidel update for each component
        for i in range(N):
            # Lower‑triangular part (uses already updated components)
            sum_lower = np.dot(A[i, :i], x[:i])
            # Upper‑triangular part (uses components from previous iteration)
            sum_upper = np.dot(A[i, i+1:], x_old[i+1:])
            x[i] = (b[i] - sum_lower - sum_upper) / diag[i]

        # Check convergence: ||x_k - x_{k-1}||_2 < eps
        if np.linalg.norm(x - x_old) < eps:
            break

    # Compute final residual and error
    residual = np.linalg.norm(A @ x - b)
    error = np.linalg.norm(x - x_true)

    return residual, error"
